name: Gästehaus Arnold
beschreibung:
Quietly yet centrally located in Soelden, Gaestehaus Arnold is an excellent hub for hikers, climbers, and skiers. Bright, tidy rooms combined with friendly service make guests feel right at home.

Major cable car stations and alpine hiking routes throughout the Oetztal valley are just a short journey away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Arnold in Soelden welcomes travellers with cosy accommodations and a great Oetztal location.
